title: The comingling of neural and body operations makes feelings

statements.text: Because the interoceptive system is not insulated from the body, neural and non-neural operations comingle, one sliding onto the other. This comingling is the main feature responsible for homeostatic feelings and so for experience and consciousness.

sources.quote: In our judgement this is the main feature responsible for homeostatic feelings, the physiological feature that most closely accounts for experiences and thus for consciousness
In each of these arrangements, the body proper and the nervous system merge, one literally sliding onto the other.
